Done. The build passes and the game is verified playable end-to-end in a real browser (both dev and production builds).

## What I reconciled and fixed

The hand-off flagged API mismatches in `Game.js`, but the real problems were broader. After reading every file and building the exact API map, I fixed:

**Bootstrap (`main.js` / `index.html`)**
- `getElementById('game-root')` → `#app` (the actual container)
- `new Arena(scene)` → `new Arena(scene, textures)` — Arena requires a `ProceduralTextures` instance
- `new Game({ engine, … })` → `new Game({ scene, … })` — Game reads `scene`, not `engine`
- Removed the dead `fx.trail` (Bullets build their own trails) and added the missing `arena.update(realDt)` (starfield + light-flash decay were never running)
- Rewrote `index.html`: the static HUD/screens used CSS class names that didn't match UI.js's generated markup at all, and the duplicate `id="hud"` broke the UI root. Now the CSS matches UI.js exactly and the dead static DOM is gone.

**Game logic (`Game.js`)**
- Menu never showed on load — constructor set `state='menu'` but never called `_setState('menu')`
- SHIELD power-up was dead — `player.hit()` (the shield absorb) was never called
- UFO never appeared — `ufo.launch()` was never triggered; added a per-wave spawn timer
- Victory state was unreachable — `MAX_WAVE` was defined but unused; wired the wave-10 → victory path

**Entity bugs**
- `Bullets.js` called `trail.reset()` — `MotionTrail` has `clear()`, not `reset()` (threw on every shot)
- `PowerUp.testCollect` returned a pickup whose type had already been reset to `'RAPID'` by the pool's release hook — so a BOMB pickup applied RAPID. Now snapshots fields before release.
- `Player.wide` was never initialized in the constructor

**Shared (`Input.js`)**
- `update()` cleared the edge-press set every frame, wiping keyboard presses that fired between frames — fast pause/start toggles silently failed. Now edges are computed as held-now vs held-last-frame.

## What I verified (real Chrome, zero runtime errors)
- Menu → LAUNCH → playing; HUD score/wave/lives correct
- Fire, move, pause/resume all work
- **Loss path**: 3 deaths → "EARTH FALLEN" game-over → RETRY restarts (reached in ~14s of real play)
- **Win path**: wave-10 clear → "GALAXY SECURED" victory → PLAY AGAIN resets to wave 1
- BOMB clears enemy bullets; SHIELD sets `player.shield`; UFO kill scores + deactivates
- Production build (`vite preview`) loads and plays identically
- `vite build` clean (39 modules), no unresolved imports, no missing methods, no stubs/placeholders

Two footguns I hit are recorded in workspace memory (the pool-reset-mutates-item trap and the Input edge-clearing bug) so they don't cost the next agent time.
